items.summary: In the mobile hamburger menu (defined in frontend/src/App.tsx), add a 'Why Choose Us' link navigating to /why-choose-us, positioned after 'About Us' and before 'Products'. The link must close the mobile menu when tapped and use the translation key nav.whyChooseUs.

In the mobile hamburger menu, add a 'Privacy Policy' link navigating to /privacy-policy, positioned immediately before 'Contact Us'. The link must close the mobile menu when tapped and use the translation key nav.privacyPolicy.

In the mobile hamburger menu, add a 'Terms & Conditions' link navigating to /terms-and-conditions, positioned after 'Privacy Policy' and before 'Contact Us'. The link must close the mobile menu when tapped and use the translation key nav.termsConditions.

Add translation keys nav.whyChooseUs, nav.privacyPolicy, and nav.termsConditions to frontend/src/translations/translations.ts for all three supported languages: English (en), Hindi (hi), and Marathi (mr). English values: 'Why Choose Us', 'Privacy Policy', 'Terms & Conditions'. Provide appropriate Hindi and Marathi translations.
